product.name: CASHIN PETRO
product.description: A cloud-based retail fuel solution that automates fuel and energy site operations including pump management, tank monitoring, payments, and store management.

product.name: Pump Management
product.description: A handheld device solution to manage fueling operations including fuel orders, pump selection, activation, and sales transactions.

product.name: Payment Management
product.description: A system to accept various digital payment methods with full compliance to ZATCA Phase 1 & 2 e-invoicing regulations.

product.name: Inventory Management
product.description: A system for real-time monitoring and control of fuel inventory, including wet stock control, leak detection, and safety measures.

product.name: Live Board
product.description: A centralized real-time dashboard consolidating station data for monitoring inventory, sales, price controls, and AI-powered insights.

product.name: Staff Management
product.description: A workforce management tool for shift scheduling, handovers, and performance tracking at fuel stations.
